category_edits.rationale: Across all four datasets, add a bounded causal frequency-change feature to history inputs: 1+0.05*tanh(log1p(previous training count)-log1p(current training count)). The first real position uses scale 1. Counts come exclusively from training interactions and persist in each model checkpoint. Candidate embeddings, GRU, readout, loss and optimizer remain fixed.

        self.register_buffer("training_item_counts", torch.zeros(itemnum + 1, dtype=torch.float32))
        dropout = dropout_rate if num_layers > 1 else 0.0

log_counts = torch.log1p(self.training_item_counts[seq])
        previous_log_counts = torch.cat((log_counts[:, :1], log_counts[:, :-1]), dim=1)
        previous_real = torch.cat((torch.zeros_like(seq[:, :1], dtype=torch.bool), seq[:, :-1].ne(0)), dim=1)
        has_previous = seq.ne(0) & previous_real
        frequency_scale = 1.0 + 0.05 * torch.tanh(previous_log_counts - log_counts) * has_previous.to(log_counts.dtype)
        emb = self.dropout(self.item_emb(seq) * frequency_scale.unsqueeze(-1))
        out, _ = self.gru(emb)
